name: Aligno
description: Aligno lets web agencies collect pinned client feedback and explicit sign-off on live websites, images, PDFs and videos, with no client login.

events.d: Create a new Aligno project by specifying its name.
Enable or disable the client review link for an asset and set password, expiry or due date.
Find projects by partial name and creation date.
Find comments on your assets, filtered by asset, status and creation date.
Find assets by project, partial name and creation date.
Get an asset by ID with its current version, latest approval status and open tracking.
